rooms.name: Mudby Square
rooms.description:
A cobbled square with an old well in the middle. From the tavern
to the north comes laughter and the clink of mugs.

rooms.name: The Merry Dragon Tavern
rooms.description: It smells of ale and smoke. A staircase leads up to the guest rooms.

rooms.name: A small guest room
rooms.description: A narrow bed and a window facing the square.

rooms.name: The Smithy
rooms.description: Heat from the forge hits you. Hammer blows echo off the walls.

rooms.name: The Temple
rooms.description: A quiet, cool temple. Candles flicker before an altar.

rooms.name: The Town Gate
rooms.description: A heavy wooden gate in the town wall. To the south a road winds towards the forest.

rooms.name: The Country Road
rooms.description: A muddy road with deep wheel ruts. Mudby's walls are visible to the north.

rooms.name: The Country Road
rooms.description: The road is lined with low stone walls and wild roses.

rooms.name: The Crossroads
rooms.description: A signpost points in every direction. The writing is too weathered to read.

rooms.name: The Meadow
rooms.description: Tall grass ripples in the wind. Butterflies dance among the flowers.

rooms.name: The Lake Shore
rooms.description: Sand and reeds. To the west a dark lake spreads out.

rooms.name: In the Lake
rooms.description: You wade waist-deep in icy water. Something moves near your feet.

rooms.name: The Forest Edge
rooms.description: The great forest begins here. The spruces stand close together.

rooms.name: Deep in the Forest
rooms.description: It is almost dark between the trees. Branches creak.

rooms.name: A Sunny Glade
rooms.description: Sunlight filters into a small glade. A lone oak stands in the middle.

rooms.name: The Dark Wood
rooms.description: Moss muffles your steps. Someone – or something – is watching you.

rooms.name: A Narrow Path
rooms.description: The path climbs towards the mountains in the south. Stones rattle underfoot.

rooms.name: At the Foot of the Mountain
rooms.description: Steep cliffs rise towards the sky. To the east a cave mouth gapes.

rooms.name: The Cave Mouth
rooms.description: Cold air flows out of the mountain. Water drips from the ceiling.

rooms.name: The Cave
rooms.description: The walls glitter with damp. A shaft leads straight down into the darkness.

rooms.name: Deep in the Cave
rooms.description: Total darkness. You hear breathing that is not your own.
